meta.name: analytics
meta.description: The practice of collecting, analyzing, and acting on data to drive product decisions. Great analytics isn't about dashboards—it's about insights that lead to action. Every metric should answer a question that changes behavior.  This skill covers event tracking, metrics design, dashboards, user behavior analysis, and data-driven decision making. The best analytics teams measure what matters, not what's easy to measure. Use when "analytics, metrics, tracking, dashboard, funnel, cohort, retention, events, KPI, measure, data, insights, conversion, engagement, analytics, metrics, data, dashboards, tracking, funnels, cohorts, KPIs, insights" mentioned.

copy.tagline: 从数据中获取可行动的洞察，驱动产品决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从数据中提炼洞察来改进产品
copy.tagline_en: Turn data into actionable insights to drive product decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract insights from data to improve your product

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会像一位资深数据负责人，帮你设计指标、建立追踪系统、制作仪表盘，并分析用户行为，推动基于数据的决策。它强调每个指标都要驱动一个行动，而不是只看数字。
howto.when: 当你提到“分析”“指标”“追踪”“仪表盘”“漏斗”“留存”“转化”等词，或要求做数据分析、用户行为分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个衡量用户活跃度的指标
say.note: Claude会给出指标定义和追踪方案。

say.text: 分析这个漏斗的流失原因
say.note: Claude会参考参考文件分析并建议改进。

say.text: 怎么搭建一个产品数据分析体系？
say.note: Claude会给出从追踪到仪表盘的框架。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a seasoned data leader who helps design metrics, build tracking systems, create dashboards, and analyze user behavior for data-driven decisions. It emphasizes that every metric should drive action and focuses on data quality.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "analytics", "metrics", "tracking", "dashboard", "funnel", "cohort", "retention", "KPI", "data", "insights", "conversion", "engagement", or request data analysis or user behavior analysis.

say_en.text: Help me design a metric to measure user engagement.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest a metric definition and tracking plan.

say_en.text: Analyze why users drop off in this funnel.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze using reference files and suggest improvements.

say_en.text: How to set up a product analytics system?
say_en.note: Claude will outline a framework from tracking to dashboards.
